verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://increase.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated Increase summary. Its documentation is also served as agent-friendly Markdown: documentation.md is a linked index of .md pages, and every docs citation is a .md URL. A machine-readable openapi.json further supports pointing an agent at the docs. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on using these files with agents, and independent or community reports of agents actually consuming them.
